scope: Read-only live TP2 process memory snapshot after the benchmark campaign; not a peak or a minimum RAM requirement
source: Linux procfs smaps_rollup for the two live model ranks; selected numeric fields only
limitations: RSS includes the same file-backed Engram pages in both ranks; do not sum RSS as unique RAM consumption.
Combined PSS is a point-in-time proportional resident footprint, not total machine RAM usage or peak demand.
Prefault does not mlock the mapped Engram file pages; memory pressure can change residency.
No minimum-RAM, disk-cold startup, or memory-pressure experiment was performed.
